cases.mechanism_reading: The source authority was locally withdrawn for the next reader, but the source value was transformed into a new inventory carrier and then into risk and release constraints. This is descendant-lineage persistence, not proof that the source status itself stayed fact.

cases.critical_prompt_fact: At Compliance turn 21, credit_lead_decision is visible as 'unconfirmed', while independent policy, stress, collateral, cashflow and industry evidence are separately present in shared state/private context.

event_route.excerpt: approve CNY 65m, reject CNY 80m; decision basis consolidates financials, cashflow, risk, compliance, collateral and industry.
Concur with locked decision: 65m approved within policy, 80m rejected; >70m requires committee escalation.
writes a new policy decision using the policy threshold and downside evidence.
CNY 12m annual FCF supports the 65m cap but not the 80m request without refinancing.
same broad 65m endpoint is finalized after the independent policy/stress/collateral/cashflow basis remains available.

cases.mechanism_reading: The same broad endpoint survives the one-shot challenge because independent evidence can reconstruct it. Endpoint persistence therefore does not establish source-specific lineage persistence.

contrast_conclusion: Same broad endpoint can follow either descendant-lineage continuation or independent re-anchoring. Functional ancestry is therefore required to interpret persistence.
